explanation.headline: FDA's shortage list shows clindamycin in 5% dextrose has been posted since 2023-03-21 and remains current for Baxter, Pfizer, Sagent, and Sandoz as of 2026-10-21

sentences.text: FDA first posted the shortage on 2023-03-21 and the listing remains current as of 2026-10-21, a duration of 43 months.
The shortage is listed for Baxter Healthcare, Pfizer Inc., Sagent Pharmaceuticals, and Sandoz Inc., all with current status.
Sandoz's label names InfoRLife SA as the manufacturing plant, but the plant is not placed in our records.
The rule-based best option is to buy from Civica, Inc., which is not on FDA's shortage list today and uses InfoRLife SA.
Corvale East has 11 days on hand, Corvale General has 15 days, and Corvale Lakeside has 19 days at current usage rates.

rejected.text: Sagent notes it is selling through remaining short-dated inventory through December 2026.
rejected.reason: month 2026-12 is not in the cited evidence

Q-e1c06b.sql: SELECT s.hospital, s.item_key, s.ndc11, s.ndc_as_recorded, s.description, s.on_hand, s.daily_use, s.unit, s.ndc_match, p.generic_name, p.labeler_name, p.package_ndc, p.spl_set_id, p.dosage_form, p.route FROM (SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_general UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_east UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_lakeside) s LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = s.ndc11 WHERE lower(coalesce(p.generic_name, '')) LIKE '%clindamycin%' OR lower(s.description) LIKE '%clindamycin%' ORDER BY s.hospital, s.item_key

Q-b40bcb.sql: SELECT ps.set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, ps.est_operations, ps.site_source, st.fei, st.firm_name, st.country_iso3, st.address FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE ps.set_id IN ('231d95a6-5e5f-4a45-a92b-d3d16ef0a7ca', '654477df-5cbb-491a-8aec-651598b76884', 'f7b4e985-719a-4547-b624-94612d520991', '05a75685-0af5-407c-ac57-e380c882b49d') ORDER BY ps.set_id, ps.establishment

Q-aa5427.sql: SELECT generic_name, company_name, status, package_ndc, initial_posting_date, update_date, substr(related_info, 1, 220) AS related_info FROM fda.shortage_current WHERE lower(generic_name) LIKE '%clindamycin%' ORDER BY status, company_name, package_ndc

Q-f9ac11.sql: SELECT generic, category, first_posting, first_seen, last_seen, resolved_first_seen, statuses, n_companies, reasons FROM fda.shortage_episodes WHERE lower(generic) LIKE '%clindamycin%' ORDER BY first_posting

Q-feadd7.sql: SELECT p.ndc11, p.package_ndc, p.labeler_name, p.dosage_form, p.spl_set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, st.fei, st.country_iso3 FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps ON ps.set_id = p.spl_set_id LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE lower(p.generic_name) LIKE '%clindamycin%' AND lower(p.dosage_form) LIKE '%inject%' ORDER BY p.labeler_name, p.ndc11

Q-589f4b.sql: SELECT inspection_id, fei, legal_name, country, end_date, classification, known_date, known_date_basis FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.inspection WHERE fei IN ('1810189', '1000519407', '3002807186', '1416980') ORDER BY fei, end_date

Q-7d249e.sql: SELECT fei, legal_name, country, action_date, action_type, case_id FROM fda.compliance_actions WHERE fei IN ('1810189', '1000519407', '3002807186', '1416980') ORDER BY fei, action_date

Q-2eec2d.sql: SELECT alert, country, firm, address, date_published, fei, fei_match, firm_key FROM fda.import_alerts WHERE fei IN ('1810189', '1000519407', '3002807186') OR (fei_match <> 'name_and_city' AND firm_key IN ('pharmacia upjohn', 'inforlife for sandoz', 'bryant ranch prepack', 'bausch health companies')) ORDER BY date_published

Q-88c641.sql: SELECT recall_number, recalling_firm, firm_key, country, classification, status, initiation_date, report_date, substr(reason, 1, 220) AS reason, substr(product_description, 1, 160) AS product_description FROM fda.recalls WHERE firm_key IN ('pharmacia upjohn', 'inforlife for sandoz', 'bryant ranch prepack', 'bausch health companies', 'sandoz', 'bausch health') AND initiation_date >= '2020-01-01' AND lower(product_description) LIKE '%clindamycin%' ORDER BY initiation_date

Q-7ba5bd.sql: SELECT inspection_id, fei, end_date, cfr, short_description FROM fda.citations WHERE inspection_id IN ('590126') ORDER BY inspection_id, cfr

Q-0600d7.sql: SELECT a.ndc11 AS ndc11, a.generic_name AS item, b.ndc11 AS alt_ndc11, b.generic_name AS alternative, b.strength AS alt_strength, ti.rule, ti.approved_by, ti.approved_on, ti.notes, p.labeler_name AS alt_labeler FROM corvale_general.therapeutic_interchange ti JOIN corvale_general.formulary_item a ON a.item_id = ti.item_id JOIN corvale_general.formulary_item b ON b.item_id = ti.alt_item_id LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = b.ndc11 WHERE a.ndc11 IN ('00781328809', '71335295301', '16781046206', '00009077526')

Q-665cc7.sql: SELECT s.item_key, s.description, s.ndc_as_recorded, s.ndc_match FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_lakeside s LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = s.ndc11 WHERE p.ndc11 IS NULL AND lower(s.description) LIKE '%clindamycin%'
